```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(data.table)
library(knitr)

top_n <- function(dt, n = 5) dt[seq_len(min(n, nrow(dt)))]
bottom_n <- function(dt, n = 5) {
  if (nrow(dt) == 0) return(dt)
  start <- max(1, nrow(dt) - n + 1)
  dt[seq(start, nrow(dt))]
}

percent <- function(x) sprintf("%.1f%%", x)
round3 <- function(x) sprintf("%.3f", x)

base_path <- "outputs"
read_csv_dt <- function(name) fread(file.path(base_path, name))

qb_air <- read_csv_dt("qb_airyards_aggressiveness_2023_readable.csv")
qb_depth <- read_csv_dt("qb_depth_splits_readable.csv")
qb_sit <- read_csv_dt("qb_situational_splits_readable.csv")
qb_conv <- read_csv_dt("qb_third_fourth_conv_readable.csv")
drive_out <- read_csv_dt("drive_outcomes_2023_readable.csv")
quartile <- read_csv_dt("airyards_quartile_summary_readable.csv")
reg_int <- read_csv_dt("regression_int_rate_coefs_readable.csv")
reg_epa <- read_csv_dt("regression_epa_coefs.csv")
```

## Approach and Filters

- QBs with at least **100 dropbacks** (from play-by-play with air yards).
- Drives shorter than **3 plays** removed for drive efficiency.
- **Regular season only** (if `season_type` present).
- Spikes, kneels, and penalties removed when columns are available.
- Air-yards bucketed: Behind LOS, Short (0–9), Intermediate (10–19), Deep (20+).
- Depth model removes throwaways/batted passes when flags are present.
- EPA is winsorized at 1st/99th percentiles for regression; quadratic depth term and pressure/play-action flags included when available.

## Depth Performance (Deep EPA, ≥20 deep attempts)

```{r deep-table}
deep_top <- qb_depth[
  depth_bucket == "Deep (20+)" & attempts >= 20 & !is.na(epa_avg)
][order(-epa_avg)]
deep_top <- top_n(deep_top, 5)[
  , .(QB = passer_player_name, Team = team, Attempts = attempts,
      `EPA/att` = round3(epa_avg), `INT rate` = int_rate_pct)
]
kable(deep_top, align = "l")
```

## Early Down Efficiency (EPA/dropback, ≥30 dropbacks)

```{r early-table}
ed <- qb_sit[early_down == TRUE & third_fourth == FALSE & dropbacks >= 30]
ed <- ed[dropbacks >= 100]  # stabilize early-down EPA
ed_top <- top_n(ed[order(-epa_per_db)], 5)[
  , .(QB = passer_player_name, Team = team, DB = dropbacks,
      `EPA/db` = round3(epa_per_db),
      `Success` = success_pct,
      `TD rate` = td_rate_pct,
      `INT rate` = int_rate_pct)
]
kable(ed_top, align = "l")
```

## 3rd/4th Down Conversions (≥30 attempts)

```{r third-table}
conv_top <- qb_conv[attempts >= 30][order(-conv_rate_pct)]
conv_top <- top_n(conv_top, 5)[
  , .(QB = passer_player_name, Team = team, Attempts = attempts,
      `Conv%` = conv_rate_pct,
      `EPA/db` = round3(epa_per_db))
]
kable(conv_top, align = "l")
```

## Team Drive Efficiency

```{r drive-table}
drive_top <- top_n(drive_out[order(-points_per_drive)], 5)[
  , .(Team = posteam,
      Drives = drives,
      `Pts/drive` = round3(points_per_drive),
      `TD rate` = td_rate_pct,
      `INT rate` = int_rate_pct)
]
drive_bottom <- top_n(drive_out[order(points_per_drive)], 5)[
  , .(Team = posteam,
      Drives = drives,
      `Pts/drive` = round3(points_per_drive),
      `TD rate` = td_rate_pct,
      `INT rate` = int_rate_pct)
]
kable(rbind(
  data.table(Side = "Top", drive_top),
  data.table(Side = "Bottom", drive_bottom)
), align = "l")
```

## Air-Yards Quartiles: Risk and Reward

Quartiles are ordinal; linear correlations can overstate effects. Use grouped summaries instead.

```{r quartile-table}
qt <- quartile[, .(
  Quartile = air_yds_quartile,
  Attempts = attempts,
  `INT rate` = int_rate_pct,
  `EPA/db` = round3(epa_avg)
)]
kable(qt, align = "l")
```

## Regression Notes

- **INT model (logit)**: predictors = air_yards + air_yards², CPOE, down, distance, score differential, pressure flag, play-action flag. Interpret odds ratios (OR > 1 increases INT odds).
- **EPA model (robust)**: winsorized EPA with air_yards + air_yards², CPOE, down, distance, score differential, pressure flag, play-action flag. Uses Huber regression (falls back to OLS if unavailable).

```{r reg-int}
kable(reg_int[, .(term, Estimate = round3(Estimate), `Std. Error` = round3(`Std. Error`),
                  `z value` = round3(`z value`), `Pr(>|z|)` = round3(`Pr(>|z|)`),
                  `Odds Ratio` = round3(odds_ratio))], align = "l")
```

```{r reg-epa}
kable(reg_epa[, .(term, Estimate = round3(Estimate), `Std. Error` = round3(`Std. Error`),
                  `t value` = round3(`t value`), `Pr(>|t|)` = round3(`Pr(>|t|)`))], align = "l")
```

## Takeaways (Scout Lens)

- Deep aggression correlates positively with EPA but raises INT risk; leaders shown here require volume filters (≥20 deep attempts) to mitigate small-sample noise.
- Early-down efficiency leaders sustain positive EPA with low INTs, setting up easier late downs; late-down conversion should be judged by conversion %, not raw EPA spikes.
- 3rd/4th-down conversion leaders pair rate with positive EPA; see full CSV for laggards.
- Pressure splits (when available) trend negative; without pressure controls, air-yard effects overstate QB-driven gains.
*Small-sample note: variance remains high near the 20-attempt cutoff; interpret EPA with caution for the smaller-volume QBs.*
